causal_reconstruction.current_status_none: Strong inference from the pinned normal control flow and preserved final state: a truthy new status would overwrite last_worker_status before the deadline branch; the retained value is still complete/setup_complete=true. With the recorded SSH endpoint present, the normal None path is a completed SSH command with nonzero exit. The failing returncode/stdout/stderr were not persisted.
not_selected_reasons: account balance reaches the experiment allocation
causal_reconstruction.retrieval_order: Termination was selected while final retrieval acceptance was absent. The collector failed in rsync and never reached final verification in the preserved attempt. The final absence-confirmation time is later than the retrieval log final mtime; it is not the timestamp of the API deletion request. The SSH reset may have been a consequence of deletion or an independent transport event; the available records do not resolve that ordering.
causal_reconstruction.timeout_exception_distinction: watch_last_error_type=TimeoutExpired and watch_consecutive_failures=1 are retained exception observations, not proof that the terminating status call raised. Those fields are not cleared on successful iterations; a raised supervision exception follows the separate three-consecutive-failures policy, whose recorded termination reason would differ.

conclusion: The watcher selected its expired setup-deadline branch after a current status observation failed to establish setup completion, despite a preserved prior complete/setup_complete=true observation. Setup completion was not latched; this branch can terminate before retrieval acceptance.

demonstrated_facts.claim: The final lease records the setup-timeout termination reason, terminated status and three account-bound absence confirmations.
Setup and experiment completion had already been observed and preserved.
The pinned watcher tests only the current status in its setup-deadline predicate; it neither consults last_worker_status nor persists a monotonic setup-completed latch.
A normal nonzero SSH exit becomes None in remote_status. A raised TimeoutExpired instead enters the exception handler and skips the setup-reason selection on that iteration.
The setup-deadline reason precedes the final retrieval-receipt branch. ensure_sync launches a separate collector, and termination does not wait on its sync lock.
The preserved collector log records a connection reset and rsync failure at the transfer call, before the after-inventory, local whole-tree verification and RETRIEVAL_VERIFIED publication.

one_bounded_future_correction.mechanism: Persist a monotonic setup-completed latch for the validated lease/pod when setup_complete is True is first observed. Apply setup_deadline only while that latch is absent. Missing later status must not clear the latch or reopen setup.
necessary_regression_scenario: Owned lease with healthy budget observes complete/setup_complete=true and persists the latch, with RETRIEVAL_VERIFIED absent and retrieval still pending.
Restart the watcher from persisted state after setup_deadline, then make SSH return nonzero so remote_status returns None.
Verify no setup-timeout termination occurs, the latch survives, and no retrieval receipt is created by the watcher.
Then supply a valid completed retrieval receipt and require the normal artifacts-retrieved-and-verified termination reason.
Control branch: without any validated setup-complete observation, an expired setup deadline and absent status must still trigger the bounded setup termination.
one_bounded_future_correction.preserved_invariants: Keep existing explicit-stop, work/spend/account deadlines, supervision-exception and valid retrieval-receipt gates. Do not fabricate retrieval acceptance or replace it with last_worker_status.
one_bounded_future_correction.scope: Recommendation only for a separately reviewed future controller revision; no historical or pinned controller was edited.
